shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -iE 'dropdown|menu|button|popup'

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ICONS_PRESENT

sed -i "s/import type { ButtonProps, DropdownMenuItem } from '@gravity-ui\/uikit';/import type { ButtonProps, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSize } from '@gravity-ui\/uikit';/; s/  size?: ButtonProps\['size'\];/  size?: DropdownMenuSize;/" src/ActionsMenu.tsx && grep -n "DropdownMenuSize" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8

sed -i "s/import type { ButtonProps, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSize } from '@gravity-ui\/uikit';/import type { ButtonProps, DropdownMenuItem } from '@gravity-ui\/uikit';\n\ntype DropdownMenuSize = 's' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl';/" src/ActionsMenu.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer'; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---"; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short && cat src/ActionsMenu.tsx
